senses.gloss:
अय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इ), going; a move towards the
right at chess; good luck, favourable fortune; a die;
N. of a Prajāpati; (अस्, आ, अम्), going, moving.
—अय-
ता, f. good luck.
—अय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, happy.
—अय-शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bright with good fortune.
—अयान्वित (अय-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, fortunate, lucky.

अया अया, ind. (fr. pronominal base अ =
अनया), Ved. in this manner, thus.

आय आय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इ with आ), arrival,
approach; income, revenue; gain, profit; the guard
of the women's apartments; the eleventh lunar man-
sion.
—आय-व्यय, अम् or औ, n. or m. du. receipt
and disbursement, income and expenditure.
—आय-
स्थान, अम्, n. a place where revenues are collected.

आया आ-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to come,
arrive, approach, reach, attain; Ved. to bring.
अयथ, अम्, n., Ved. a leg, foot (?).

अयथा अ-यथा, ind. not as it should be,
unfitly, unsuitably.
—अ-यथम्, Ved. without effort.
—अ-यथा-तथ, अस्, आ, अम्, not so as it should be,
[]
unfit, unsuitable; useless, unprofitable, vain; (अम्),
ind. unfitly, unsuitably.
—अ-यथा-तथ्य, अम्, n.
unsuitableness, unprofitableness, incompatibility.
—अ-
यथा-द्योतन, अम्, n. intimation of something
unexpected.
—अ-यथा-पूर्व or अ-यथा-पुर, अस्,
आ, अम्, unprecedented.
—अ-यथा-बलम्, ind. not
according to one's power.
—अ-यथा-मात्र, अस्, आ,
अम्, not according to measure.
—अ-यथामुखीन,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the face turned away.
—अ-य-
थार्थ (˚था-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not according to
the sense or object, incongruous, unmeaning, non-
sensical; improper, unfitting.
—अ-यथा-वत्, ind.
inaccurately, erroneously.
—अ-यथाशास्त्र-कारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, not acting in accordance with the scripture.
—अ-यथेष्ट (˚था-इष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not as
wished; disliked, disapproved of; insufficient, not
enough.
—अ-यथोचित (˚था-उच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, un-
worthily, unsuitably.

अयन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. इ), going; especially
at the end of a compound, e. g. समुद्रायण, going
to the ocean; (अम्), n. going, walking, walk; a road,
a path; a place, a site (?); course, circulation,
period; final emancipation; a commentary, treatise;
N. of certain sacrificial performances; the sun's
road north and south of the equator, the half
year; the equinoctial and solstitial points; way,
progress, manner; a Śāstra or inspired writing.
—अयन-काल, अस्, m. the interval between the equi-
noxes.
—अयन-देवता, f. a deity or an idol placed
near a road (?).
—अयन-भाग, अस्, m. or अय-
नांश (˚न-अं˚), अस्, m. the arc between the vernal
equinoctial point and the beginning of the fixed
zodiac or first point in Aries.
—अयन-वलन, अम्,
n. deviation of the ecliptic.
—अयन-वृत्त, अम्,
n. the ecliptic.
अयन अयन, &c. See under अय्, p. 78.

अयान अ-यान, अम्, n. not moving, halting,
stopping; natural disposition or temperament: (in the
last sense the etymology is doubtful.)
आयन, अम्, n., Ved. coming.

आ-यान, अम्, n. coming, arrival; the natural tem-
perament or disposition.

अयक्ष्म अ-यक्ष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not con-
sumptive; not sick, healthy; causing health; (अम्),
n. health.
—अयक्ष्म-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved.
producing health.
—अयक्ष्म-ताति, इस्, f. or अय-
क्ष्म-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. freedom from consump-
tion; health.

अयक्ष्यमाण अ-यक्ष्यमाण, अस्, m. not
wishing or not about to sacrifice.

अयजुष्क अ-यजुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. with-
out a sacrificial formula or verse.

अयज्ञ अ-यज्ञ, अस्, m. no sacrifice; a bad
sacrifice; (अस्, आ, अम्), not offering sacrifice.
—अ-
यज्ञ-साच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. not performing a sacrifice,
performing worthless sacrifices.
अ-यज्ञक, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit for sacrifice.

अ-यज्ञिय, अस्, आ, अम्, not fit for sacrifice; not
worthy of sacrifice, profane, common.

अ-यज्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not sacrificing, impious,
profane, wicked.

आ-यज्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. endeavouring to gain;
inclined to sacrifice.
अ-यज्वन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. not offering sacrifice, profane.

अयज्ञदत्त अ-यज्ञदत्त, अस्, m. not Yajña-
datta, i. e. the vile Yajñadatta.

अयत् अ-यत्, त्, त्, त् (rt. यम्), not making
efforts.

1. आ-यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, coming, approaching.
—आयती-
गवम्, ind. at the time when the cows come home.
—आयद्-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one to whom goods
come.

आयत् 2. आ-यत्, cl. 1. A. -यतते, -तितुम्, to
make effort; to rest on, to depend on, to have the
upper hand (?).

अ-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, unrestrained, uncontrolled,
unchecked.

आ-यत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, dependant, tractable, docile.
—अयत्त-ता, f. or आयत्त-त्व, अम्, n. dependence,
humility, tractableness, docility.

आ-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, long; diffuse, prolix; (अस्), m.
an oblong figure (in geometry).
—आयत-च्छदा, f.
the plantain tree Musa Paradisiaca Lin.
—आयत-
स्तू, ऊस्, m. a panegyrist.
—आयताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्,
ई, अम्, having large eyes or long eyelids.
—आयता-
पाङ्ग (˚त-अप्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having a long-cornered
eye.
—आयतायति (˚त-आय्˚), इस्, f. long continu-
ance, remote futurity.
—आयतार्ध (˚त-अर्ध्˚), अस्,
m. (in geometry) half an oblong.
—आयतेक्षण
(˚त-ईक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, long-eyed, having long or
large eyes.

आ-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, come; (अम्), n. excess, super-
abundance.

अ-यतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, of unsubdued appetite; incon-
tinent.

अयत्न, अस्, m. absence of effort or exertion;
अयत्नेन or अयत्नात् or अयत्नतस्, without effort
or exertion.
—अ-यत्न-कारिन्, ई, इनी, इ, making no
exertion, indifferent, idle.
—अ-यत्न-कृत or अ-
यत्न-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, easily or readily produced,
spontaneous.
—अयत्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, inactive,
indifferent, idle.

अयदीक्षित अय-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of an
author.

अयन्त्र अ-यन्त्र, अम्, n., Ved. non-restraint,
not a means of restraining; having no restraint; a
powerful weapon for restraining enemies.

अ-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, unhindered, unrestrained,
self-willed.

अयमित अ-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, unchecked,
untrimmed, unpaired, unclipped.
आ-यामित, अस्, आ, अम्, lengthened out, extended.

अयव 1. अयव, अस्, आ, अम्, deficient; (अस्),
m., N. of a worm bred in the intestines.

अयव 2. अ-यव, अस्, m. or अ-यवन्, आ, m.
or अ-यवस्, अस्, n. the dark half of the month.

अयव 3. अ-यव, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-यवक,
अस्, इका, अम्, having worthless or no barley.
अ-यवय, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit for barley.

अयशस् अ-यशस्, अस्, n. infamy; (आस्, आस्,
अस्), infamous, disagreeable.
—अयशस्-कर, अस्, आ,
or ई, अम्, disgraceful, degrading.
अ-यशस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, infamous.

अयस् अयस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. rt. इ), going,
nimble; (अस्), n. iron, steel, gold, metal [cf. Lat.
œs, œr-is for œs-is; Goth. ais, Them. aisa;
Old Germ. êr, ‘iron;’ Goth. eisarn; Mod. Germ.
Eisen]; (आस्), m. fire.
—अयः-पान, अम्, n. a par-
ticular hell.
—अयः-प्रतिमा, f. iron image.
—अयः-
शङ्कु, उस्, m., N. of an Asura.
—अयः-शय, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. lying in iron, made of iron (said of fire).
—अयः-शिप्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having jaws or
a nose of iron.
—अयः-शिरस्, आस्, m., N. of an
Asura.
—अयः-शीर्षन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having a
head of iron.
—अयः-शूल, अम्, n. an iron lance;
fraudulent or cunning artifice.
—अयः-स्थूण or
अयस्-स्थूण or अय-स्थूण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having
iron pillars or spikes; (अस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
—अयश्-
चूर्ण, अम्, n. iron filings.
—अयस्-कंस, अस्, अम्,
m. n. an iron goblet.
—अयस्-काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n.
an iron arrow.
—अयस्-कान्त, अस्, m. a precious stone,
the loadstone.
—अयस्-कार, अस्, m. a blacksmith;
the upper part of the thigh (?).
—अयस्-कीट, अम्, n.
rust of iron.
—अयस्-कुम्भ, अस्, ई, m. f. an iron
pot or boiler.
—अयस्-कुशा, f. a rope partly consist-
ing of iron.
—अयस्-कृति, इस्, f. preparation of iron.
—अयस्-ताप, अस्, आ, अम्, making iron red-hot.
—अयस्-पात्र, अम्, n. an iron vessel.
—अयस्-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. made of iron or of metal; (अस्), m.,
N. of a son of Manu Svārociṣa; (ई), f., N. of one
of the three residences of the Asuras.
For compounds beginning अयो, see s.v. अयो-गुड.

अयास् अ-यास् (?), आस्, m. (rt. यस्), Ved. agile
(without effort), dexterous, nimble; (आस्), ind. fire (?).

आयस् आ-यस्, cl. 4. P. -यस्यति, -सितुम्, to
exert one's self, to weary one's self, become exhausted:
Caus. -यासयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to weary, worry.

अयस may be used for अयस् at the end of com-
pounds, as कृष्णायस, q. v.

आ-यास, अस्, m. effort, exertion (of bodily or mental
power), trouble, labour; fatigue, weariness.

आयस आयस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अयस्), of iron,
made of iron or metal, metallic; armed with an iron
weapon; zealous ?; (ई), f. armour for the body, a
breastplate, a coat of mail; (अम्), n. iron; anything
made of iron; a weapon; a wind-instrument.

अयाचक अ-याचक, अस्, इका, अम् (rt. याच्),
one who does not ask or solicit.

अ-यचित, अस्, आ, अम्, unasked, unsolicited; अया-
[]
चितम्, ind. without being asked; (अस्), m., N. of
the Ṛṣi Upavarṣa.
—अयाचित-वृत्ति, इस्, f. or
अयाचित-व्रत, अम्, n. subsisting on alms without
begging.

आयाचित आ-याचित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. याच्),
urgently requested or desired.
अ-याचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not soliciting.

अयाज्य अ-याज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. यज्), a person
or thing for whom or for which one must not offer
sacrifices; outcast, degraded; not competent to offer
sacrifice; incapable of or inadmissible to religious
ceremonies.
—अयाज्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of an
outcast.
—अयाज्य-याजन or अयाज्य-संयाज्य, अम्,
n. sacrificing for an outcast.

अयातपूर्व अ-यात-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, follow-
ing, subsequent to, succeeding.

अयातयाम अ-यातयाम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not
weak; not worn out by use; fresh; (अम्), n., N. of
certain texts of the Yajur-veda, revealed to Yājiñaval-
kya.
—अयातयाम-ता, f., Ved. unweakened strength,
freshness.
अ-यातयामन्, आ, म्नी, अ, Ved. not weak, fresh.

अयातु अ-यातु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not demoni-
acal; free from evil spirits; (उस्), m. not a demon,
the opposite of an evil spirit.

अयाथार्थिक अ-याथार्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, impro-
per, unjust; not genuine, not real, incongruous, absurd.

अ-याथार्थ्य, अम्, n. impropriety, unfitness, ab-
surdity, nonsense.

अयानय अयानय (˚य-अन्˚), अम्, n. good
and bad luck; (अस्), m. a particular position of the
pieces on a chess or backgammon board.

अयानयीन, अस्, m. a piece at chess or backgam-
mon so moved.

अयावक अ-यावक, अस्, आ, अम्, unstained
with lac-dye, naturally red.

अयावन अ-यावन, अम्, n. not causing to
unite.

आयवन आ-यवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. यु with
आ), Ved. a spoon for stirring, any similar implement.

अयाशु अ-याशु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. unfit for
copulation.

अ-यास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not to be obtained by
effort, indefatigable; valiant; enterprising; (अस्), m.,
N. of an Aṅgiras; mystical name of the chief vital air.

अयासोमीय अयासोमीय, अम्, n., N. of some
verses of the Sāma-veda.

आयःशूलिक आयःशूलिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अयः-
शूल), active, diligent, indefatigable; (अस्), m. a
man who, in order to obtain an object, uses forcible
instead of gentle means; as, for instance, a beggar who
holds a lance to your breast in asking for alms.

आयज् आ-यज्, cl. 1. A. -यजते, -यष्टुम्,
to honour (the gods); to give, present.

आ-यजि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. procuring, granting; (Sāy.)
accomplishing sacrifices from all sides.

आ-यजिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. procuring most or
best; (Sāy.) sacrificing best.

आ-याग, अस्, m. a gift given at a sacrifice.
—आया-
ग-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained by sacrifice.

आ-यतन, अम्, n. resting-place, support, seat,
place, home, house, abode; the place of the sacred
fire, an altar, a shed for sacrifices; a sanctuary; a
ground-plot, the site of a house; a barn; (with Bud-
dhists) an inner seat (the five senses and Manas are
considered as the six inner seats or āyatanas); the
[]
cause of disease.
—आयतन-त्व, अम्, n. state of
being an altar or seat.
—आयतन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. having a certain seat or home; (आन्), m., N.
of the fourth foot of Brahmā.

आ-यति, इस्, f. extension, length; stretching the
hand, accepting, obtaining; connection, junction;
meeting; following or future time; the future, ‘the
long run;’ majesty, dignity; restraint of mind; N.
of a daughter of Meru.
—आयति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
long, extended; stately, dignified; self-restrained.

आ-याति, इस्, f. coming near, arrival; (इस्), m., N. of
a son of Nahuṣa.

आयथातथ्य आयथातथ्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-य-
थातथ), unsuitableness, unfitness, incompatibility.

आयम् आ-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्,
to stretch, lengthen out, extend, restrain; A. -यच्-
छते, to stretch one's self or be stretched, to grow
long; to grasp, possess: Caus. -यामयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
to lengthen, &c.

आ-यन्तृ, ता, m., Ved. one who fastens or raises;
(Sāy.) one who approaches.
आ-यमन, अम्, n. stretching (as a bow).

1. आ-यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stretched; to be
restrained.

2. आ-यम्य or आ-यत्य, ind. having restrained,
suppressed or stretched.

आ-याम, अस्, m. stretching, extending; restraining,
restraint, stopping; expansion, length (either in space
or time), breadth (in mensuration).
—आयाम-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, extended, long.

आ-यामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who restrains, long in
space or time.

आयल्लक आयल्लक, अम्, n. impatience, long-
ing for, missing, regretting (etym. doubtful).

आयवस आ-यवस, अस् or अम् (?), m. n., Ved.
pasture-ground, place for feeding; (अस्), m., N. of a
man (?).

आ-यस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pained, distressed; vexed,
angry; hurt, killed; managed or effected with diffi-
culty; labouring, toiling, making effort or exertion;
sharpened, whetted; thrown, cast, sent.

आ-यासक, अस्, ई, अम्, causing effort, fatigue or
weariness.

आ-यासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, making exertion, active, labo-
rious; exhausted by labour, wearied.

आयस्कार आयस्कार, अस्, m. the upper part
of the thigh of an elephant. See अयस्-कार.
आ-यापन, अम्, n. causing to come, inviting.
